station_approach_comparison.interpretation: 35mm is a feed-capped final straight XY zone at Z35, not a guarantee of safe braking. Deceleration to its F3000 cap begins upstream under lookahead; the final XY-to-Z corner constrains speed again. Short paths shrink edge zones and omit the high-speed middle. Finite buffer, feed override, tool/wet dynamics and continuous UGS TCP streaming still need a trial.
